sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the accused-applicant has no property worth Rs.
30,00,000/-.
He has one house of one BHK which is also mortgaged.

In respect of making deposit of Rs. 30,00,000/-, he submitted that the accused-applicant does not have means to deposit Rs.
30,00,000/- but he is willing to deposit the passport of his wife as surety.
Learned counsel for the accused-applicant also submits that he needs his passport for a period of one month to settle his dues with his employer at Doha.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, the trial court is directed to release the pass-port of the accused-applicant for a period of one month only.
The accused-applicant shall deposit the valid pass-port of his wife as a security and after one month he should deposit back his pass-port on which the passport of his wife shall be released.
The trial court may impose any other condition which it deems fit and proper to release the pass-port of the accused-applicant.
With the aforesaid direction the present petition is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Kumar Manish.
